procedure: one fresh process per arm over the masked lock's canonical paths in lock order, the reference first, then candidate A, then candidate B, each under an exclusive hold on the host CPU lock; every record's plan must name the arm's prefill attention exactly (reference avx512-wide, A avx512-wide-static, B bf16-static); each arm's JSON lines converted by research/corpus-qualification/scripts/bench_report_from_run.py --lock reference/near-exact-softmax-gate-v1-masked-lock.json, which requires every lock page once, in order, with the lock's pixels; each candidate scored separately against the reference by check_heldout.py, one verdict per candidate
scope: pages where the reference (near-exact with the online softmax) ends at EOS
cer: raw-text Levenshtein distance to ground-truth.txt divided by ground-truth length, micro-averaged over characters, same treatment for both runs (research/phase4-hillclimb/attempt3/check_heldout.py --reference-report)
criteria_note: check_heldout.py names the reference `fp32`; here it is near-exact with the online softmax, not FP32, so `repetition_stop_fires_on_fp32_eos_pages` counts the candidate's repetition stops on pages where the online softmax ends at EOS
noise_note: the model reads Chinese poorly (FP32 micro CER, whitespace-collapsed, 31% to 179% by category on corpus v3's 84 simplified Chinese evaluation pages; reference/quality-regression-v3-fp32-complete-v1.json), so a page whose output diverges can change its CER by tens of points; one such page moves its category by about its CER change times its share of the category's ground-truth characters (30 pt on one of 30 equal pages is 1 pt). The verdict stands as registered either way
reported_not_gated: categories with fewer than 10 reference-EOS pages (ordinary has 9 pages, so it is never gated)
time: not comparable, the arms run one after the other on a shared host
